section.content: The utility model provides a gene kit for biological gene belongs to the gene kit field, including the kit, kit one side articulates there is flip, the inside activity of kit is provided with the storing part that is used for storing the reagent pipe, the utility model discloses a put into the inside back of storage tank with the reagent pipe, press the reagent pipe once more, let the reagent pipe push down the rubber pad, the rubber pad that descends at this moment will let the annular plate rotatory, thereby let two sets of slide bars carry grip block and silica gel pad carry out the centre gripping with the reagent pipe, and just when the slide bar moved the card pole contact slide bar one side, the card pole will be forced to rise, until the slide bar is with reagent pipe centre gripping completely, the existence of silica gel pad so far can be further promote the stability of reagent pipe, plus two sets of grip block is located reagent pipe upper portion, one is located reagent pipe middle section part, thereby can promote the stability that the reagent pipe was deposited once more, thereby the stability that the reagent pipe was deposited has been improved.

本实用提出了一种生物基因用基因试剂盒，属于基因试剂盒领域，包括试剂盒，所述试剂盒一侧铰接有翻盖，所述试剂盒内部活动设置有用于储存试剂管的储物部件；本实用通过将试剂管放入到存放槽内部之后，再次按压试剂管，让试剂管将橡胶垫往下压，此时下降的橡胶垫就会让环板旋转，从而让两组滑杆带着夹持板与硅胶垫将试剂管进行夹持，而就在滑杆移动的同时卡杆接触到滑杆一侧时，卡杆就会被迫上升，直到滑杆完全将试剂管夹持，至此硅胶垫的存在能够进一步的提升试剂管的稳定性，外加两组夹持板一个位于试剂管上半部分，一个位于试剂管中段部分，从而能够再一次提升试剂管存放的稳定性，从而提高了试剂管存放的稳定性。

Gene kit for biological genesTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of gene kits, in particular to a gene kit for biological genes.

Background

The gene kit is a convenient detection tool, can rapidly and accurately analyze genes by collecting samples such as saliva, blood and tissues and applying technologies such as PCR, sequencing and the like, and can be used for disease risk assessment, genetic characteristic identification, tumor gene detection, biological scientific research and the like, however, the existing common reagent storage mode is to directly place the kit in a hole of a storage rack, but the hole of the kit is not completely attached to a reagent tube, a certain gap is commonly formed between the kit and the reagent tube, and the stability of the reagent tube is reduced when the reagent tube is stored.

Disclosure of utility model

The utility model aims to provide a gene kit for biological genes, which adopts the device to work, thereby solving the problem that the storage stability of a reagent tube is reduced due to gaps when the reagent tube is stored in the existing kit.

In order to achieve the aim, the utility model provides the technical scheme that a gene kit for biological genes, which is hinged with a flip cover at one side, is internally and movably provided with a storage part for storing a reagent tube;

The storing part is including the activity setting at the inside storing board of kit, the inside clamping assembly that is used for fixed centre gripping reagent pipe that is provided with of storing board, clamping assembly is provided with two sets of, two sets of clamping assembly is located reagent pipe both sides, storing board bottom activity is provided with the linkage subassembly that is used for driving clamping assembly and removes, storing board surface activity is provided with the locking subassembly that is used for fixed clamping assembly.

Further, the clamping assembly comprises a sliding rod movably arranged inside the storage plate, the inner wall of the sliding rod is fixedly provided with a clamping plate, two groups of clamping plates are arranged, the inner wall of the clamping plate is fixedly provided with a silica gel pad, the upper surface of the sliding rod is fixedly provided with a clamping groove, one side of the sliding rod is fixedly provided with a rack, the lower surface of the rack is flush with the lower surface of the sliding rod, and the linkage assembly is positioned between the two groups of racks.

Further, the linkage subassembly is including the activity setting at the inside annular plate of storing board, the thread groove has been seted up to annular plate inner wall, annular plate surface cover is equipped with gear B, the inside activity of annular plate is provided with the stand, stand top fixed mounting has the rubber pad, fixed surface installs the spring beam under the rubber pad, stand surface gomphosis is provided with the ball, ball and thread groove looks adaptation, gear B meshes with the rack, the rubber pad is located under the reagent pipe.

Further, the locking component comprises a clamping rod movably mounted on the surface of the storage plate, a rectangular plate is fixedly mounted at the top of the clamping rod, a slope is formed in the bottom of the clamping rod, a spring is fixedly mounted on the lower surface of the rectangular plate, one end of the spring is fixedly mounted on the surface of the storage plate, and the clamping rod is matched with the clamping groove.

Further, the sleeve plate is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the storage plate, a rectangular groove is formed in the storage plate, a group of clamping plates are slidably connected with the rectangular groove, a sliding groove is formed in the inner wall of the storage plate, the sliding rod is slidably connected with the sliding groove, a round hole is formed in the bottom of the storage plate, the lower surface of the annular plate is movably connected with the bottom of the round hole, and the lower surface of the spring rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the round hole.

Further, kit one side fixed mounting has the rear box, the inside perpendicular groove of having seted up of kit, perpendicular groove and sleeve board sliding connection, it is provided with the threaded rod to erect the inslot, threaded rod and sleeve board threaded connection, threaded rod surface fixed mounting has gear A, gear A is located the sleeve board below, the inside activity of kit is provided with the pinion rack, the first half section of pinion rack is located the inside swing joint of rear box, the latter half section of pinion rack is located the rear box inside, pinion rack one side is provided with the tooth, tooth and gear A mesh, flip one side fixed mounting has the clamp plate.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the following beneficial effects:

According to the gene reagent kit for the biological genes, when the reagent tubes are required to be stored, the turnover cover is turned over, the pressing plate presses the toothed plate to enable the toothed plate to move so as to enable the storage plate to extend out of the interior of the reagent kit, then the reagent tubes are stored in the storage opening, then when the reagent tubes are contacted with the rubber pads, the reagent tubes are pressed, the upright posts are lowered and simultaneously driven to rotate so as to enable the two groups of clamping components to be close to each other, finally the clamping plates carry the silica gel pads to fixedly clamp the reagent tubes, the stability of the reagent tubes can be further improved due to the existence of the silica gel pads, one clamping plate is located at the upper half part of the reagent tubes, and the other clamping plate is located at the middle part of the reagent tubes, so that the storage stability of the reagent tubes can be improved again, and the storage stability of the reagent tubes is improved.

In the figure, 1, a kit, 11, a rear box, 12, a threaded rod, 13, a gear A, 14, a toothed plate, 2, a flip cover, 21, a pressing plate, 3, a storage part, 31, a storage plate, 32, a sleeve plate, 33, a rectangular groove, 34, a round hole, 35, a sliding groove, 36, a clamping component, 361, a sliding rod, 362, a clamping plate, 363, a silica gel pad, 364, a rack, 365, a clamping groove, 37, a linkage component, 371, a ring plate, 372, a threaded groove, 373, a gear B, 374, a stand column, 375, a rubber pad, 376, a spring rod, 377, a ball, 38, a locking component, 381, a clamping rod, 382, a rectangular plate, 383, a slope, 384 and a spring.

Detailed Description

The following description of the embodiments of the present utility model will be made clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings, in which it is apparent that the embodiments described are only some embodiments of the present utility model, but not all embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be made by those skilled in the art based on the embodiments of the utility model without making any inventive effort, are intended to be within the scope of the utility model.

1-8, A gene kit for biological genes comprises a kit 1, wherein one side of the kit 1 is hinged with a flip cover 2, and a storage part 3 for storing a reagent tube is movably arranged in the kit 1;

The storing part 3 includes the movable storing board 31 that sets up inside the kit 1, storing board 31 inside is provided with the clamping component 36 that is used for fixed centre gripping reagent pipe, clamping component 36 is provided with two sets of clamping component 36, two sets of clamping component 36 are located reagent pipe both sides, storing board 31 bottom activity is provided with the link assembly 37 that is used for driving clamping component 36 and removes, storing board 31 surface activity is provided with the locking component 38 that is used for fixed clamping component 36, when reagent pipe put into storing board 31 inside, reagent pipe bottom will contact link assembly 37 so will link assembly 37 pushes down, two sets of clamping component 36 will draw close gradually along with the decline of link assembly 37 this moment, thereby let clamping component 36 carry out the centre gripping with the reagent pipe, after clamping component 36 will be fixed clamping component 36 with the clamping component 36.

The clamping assembly 36 comprises a sliding rod 361 movably arranged inside the storage plate 31, clamping plates 362 are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the sliding rod 361, two groups of clamping plates 362 are arranged on the inner wall of the two groups of clamping plates 362, silica gel pads 363 are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the sliding rod 361, a clamping groove 365 is fixedly arranged on one side of the sliding rod 361, a rack 364 is fixedly arranged on one side of the sliding rod 364, the lower surface of the rack 364 is flush with the lower surface of the sliding rod 361, the linkage assembly 37 is positioned between the two groups of racks 364, the reagent tube can be clamped through the clamping plates 362, the stability of the reagent tube can be further improved through the silica gel pads 363, and the stability of the reagent tube can be improved again through the clamping plates 362 at the position, due to the fact that one group of clamping plates 362 are positioned at the middle section part of the reagent tube.

The linkage assembly 37 includes the movable ring plate 371 that sets up in the storing board 31 inside, the screw groove 372 has been seted up to ring plate 371 inner wall, ring plate 371 surface cover is equipped with gear B373, the inside activity of ring plate 371 is provided with stand 374, stand 374 top fixed mounting has rubber pad 375, fixed surface installs spring rod 376 under the rubber pad 375, stand 374 surface gomphosis is provided with ball 377, ball 377 and screw groove 372 looks adaptation, gear B373 meshes with rack 364, rubber pad 375 is located under the reagent pipe, after the reagent pipe deposited to storing board 31 inside contact rubber pad 375, push down rubber pad 375 and let rubber pad 375 take stand 374 and ball 377 to descend, at this moment because stand 374 can only follow the vertical direction and ring plate 371 can only rotate in storing board 31 inside, so will drive ring plate 371 rotation when ball 377 descends, thereby let rotatory gear B373 let two sets of racks bring slide bar 361, be close to each other, thereby carry out the centre gripping with the reagent pipe.

The locking component 38 comprises a clamping rod 381 movably mounted on the surface of the storage plate 31, a rectangular plate 382 is fixedly mounted on the top of the clamping rod 381, a slope 383 is formed at the bottom of the clamping rod 381, a spring 384 is fixedly mounted on the lower surface of the rectangular plate 382, one end of the spring 384 is fixedly mounted on the surface of the storage plate 31, the clamping rod 381 is matched with the clamping groove 365, the sliding rod 361 horizontally moves through the slope 383, and when the clamping rod 381 contacts the surface of the clamping rod 381, the clamping rod 381 is forced to move upwards due to the slope 383 until the clamping rod 381 contacts the clamping groove 365 to fix the sliding rod 361.

The sleeve plate 32 is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the storage plate 31, the rectangular groove 33 is formed in the storage plate 31, the group of clamping plates 362 are slidably connected with the rectangular groove 33, the sliding groove 35 is formed in the inner wall of the storage plate 31, the sliding rod 361 is slidably connected with the sliding groove 35, the round hole 34 is formed in the bottom of the storage plate 31, the lower surface of the ring plate 371 is movably connected with the bottom of the round hole 34, the lower surface of the spring rod 376 is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the round hole 34, the stability of the clamping assembly 36 during movement can be improved through the sliding groove 35, the upper half part of the reagent tube can be clamped through the rectangular groove 33 and the group of clamping plates 362, and finally the linkage assembly 37 can be stored through the round hole 34.

The kit 1 one side fixed mounting has back case 11, the inside perpendicular groove of having seted up of kit 1, perpendicular groove and cover plate 32 sliding connection, perpendicular inslot portion is provided with threaded rod 12, threaded rod 12 and cover plate 32 threaded connection, threaded rod 12 surface fixed mounting has gear A13, gear A13 is located cover plate 32 below, the inside activity of kit 1 is provided with pinion rack 14, the first half section of pinion rack 14 is located the inside swing joint of back case 11, the latter half section of pinion rack 14 is located inside back case 11, pinion rack 14 one side is provided with the tooth, tooth meshes with gear A13, flip 2 one side fixed mounting has clamp plate 21, when the reagent pipe needs to be got rid of, flip 2 upset, will contact pinion rack 14 one end along with flip clamp plate 21 of flip 2, thereby carry pinion rack 14 removal, tooth rack 14 that has the tooth will let threaded rod 12 rotate this moment, thereby let storage plate 31 take out with the reagent pipe, thereby make things convenient for taking out of reagent pipe.

Specifically, when the reagent tube is required to be stored, the cover 2 is turned over, the pressing plate 21 gradually approaches one end of the toothed plate 14 while the cover 2 is turned over, and presses the toothed plate 14, the toothed teeth on one side of the toothed plate 14 are rotated with the gear a13, the gear a13 is rotated with the threaded rod 12, the sleeve plate 32 screwed with the threaded rod 12 is lifted up with the storage plate 31, the storage plate 31 protrudes from the inside of the reagent box 1, then the reagent tube can be stored, when the reagent tube is stored in the storage tank, the bottom of the reagent tube is preferentially contacted with the rubber pad 375, the rubber pad 375 is lifted down with the upright post 374, the annular plate 371 can only rotate in the vertical direction because the upright post 374 is lifted down with the ball 377, the annular plate 371 is rotated while the two sets of racks 364 meshed with the gear B373 are gradually approaching the reagent tube with the slide bars 361, when the sliding rod 361 moves to gradually contact the surface of the clamping rod 381, the slope 383 on the lower surface of the clamping rod 381 extrudes the sliding rod 361, so that the clamping rod 381 is forced to rise, the lower surface of the clamping rod 381 contacts with the upper surface of the sliding rod 361 until the upright post 374 completely enters the inside of the ring plate 371, at the moment, the clamping plates 362 on one side of the two groups of sliding rods 361 are matched with the silica gel pad 363 to clamp the reagent tube, the clamping rod 381 also enters the clamping groove 365, so that the position of the sliding rod 361 is fixed, when the reagent tube needs to be taken out, the rectangular plate 382 is pulled up, so that the existence of the silica gel pad 363 can further improve the stability of the reagent tube, one clamping plate 362 is positioned on the upper half part of the reagent tube, one clamping plate 362 is positioned on the middle part of the reagent tube, so that the storage stability of the reagent tube can be improved again, thereby improving the storage stability of the reagent tube.
